message: Written on the wire as data-signals:hs-flag, which Datastar reads back as the signal $hsFlag: the browser lowercases attribute names, so a key is kebab-case. In HTML or a template you write it that way yourself.
No markup or code in the project defines the signal 'hsName'. Did you mean $@name?

interpolate always throws here: title lands in data-attr:title, which Datastar runs as an expression or follows as a signal path, and only a number or a boolean is let in there. Put the value in an attribute of its own, such as data-label, and read it in the expression with el.dataset.label.
